# möbius Gateway 0.8.0

- Bundles möbius 0.8.0 and advances the frontend protocol to version 27.
- Exposes durable compaction totals, prompt-cache outcomes, estimated model cost, and richer run statistics to connected clients.
- Adds content-addressed session-file storage, 50 MiB uploads, restored artifact catalogs, workspace file browsing, Git diffs, and branch switching.
- Improves multi-chat lifecycle handling, provider configuration refreshes, client inventory, replay bounds, and authenticated file delivery.
